notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it, checked against the Board's sample ballots. Issue wording is the Board's summary; the full wording is on the sample ballot.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.
Wayne County's ballots do not number local issues (only State Issue 3 has a number); they are listed here in the Board's order.

issues.title: Charter amendment: Article II, Section 2.09 (Mayor's salary)
issues.text: Change the Mayor's salary rate in the Charter from $11,250 to $15,000, unless otherwise approved by the voters for the next term of office.

issues.title: Charter amendment: Article III, Section 3.08 (Council salaries)
issues.text: Change Council members' salary rate from $7,500 to $10,000 and the President of Council's from $8,500 to $11,000, unless otherwise approved by the voters for the next term of office.

issues.title: Charter amendment: Article IV, Section 4.03 (Administrative Officer supervision of Finance and Law)
issues.text: Place the Department of Finance and Department of Law under the direct administrative supervision of the Administrative Officer, while preserving the existing appointment and removal provisions and the legally vested fiscal and professional legal duties of those offices.

issues.title: Charter amendment: Article V, Section 5.03.B (Board of Control contract approval)
issues.text: Raise the contract amount requiring Board of Control approval from five thousand dollars to ten thousand dollars.

issues.title: Charter amendment: Title of the chief legal officer
issues.text: Change the title of the City's chief legal officer from Solicitor to Director of Law, without changing the appointment, qualifications, powers, duties, suspension or removal provisions applicable to that office.

issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #1: Section 9.05
issues.text: Eliminate outdated language regarding the civil service status of employees and add a new section allowing for the removal of a member of City Council by other members of City Council for bad behavior, criminal conduct, or absenteeism.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #2: Articles III, IV, VII, XII and XIII
issues.text: Change the date of the organizational meeting, change the date that elected officials take office, and change the deadline that nominating petitions for elective offices in the municipality must be submitted to the Board of Elections.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #3: Section 3.06

issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #4: Section 4.03
issues.text: Clarify language that the Mayor, when invited, is only an attendee and does not preside over executive sessions of City Council.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #5: Section 4.05
issues.text: Clarify the procedure by which a member of City Council is nominated to and can become Mayor in the event the office of Mayor becomes vacant.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #6: Section 5.01
issues.text: Require an annual review of the Municipal Manager by City Council.

issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #7: Articles VI and IX
issues.text: Change language to reflect that the Fire and EMS departments have merged into one department.

issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #8: Section 6.05
issues.text: Require that the Law Director be an attorney-at-law in good standing with the state bar association and oversee representation of the City in all cases as well as provide direct representation.

issues.jurisdiction: City of Rittman (Wayne and Medina counties)
issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #9: Section 9.01

issues.title: Proposed charter amendment #10: Section 9.02
